question: 1813? What was the primary focus of the 1812 House of Commons Committee before the renewal of the East India Company's Charter in

options.text: Judicial and police administration in India

solution: The correct answer is __**Judicial and police administration in India**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **1812 House of Commons Committee** was formed before the renewal of the East India Company’s charter in **1813**. Its primary focus was on evaluating various aspects of British administration in India. • The committee extensively examined the **Judicial and Police Administration** in India to address inefficiencies and issues in governance under the East India Company. • They emphasized the importance of establishing a more structured and effective judicial system to ensure law and order in the Indian territories governed by the company. • The committee also reviewed the condition of **police forces** in India, aiming to improve their functioning for better crime prevention and public safety. • This focus was significant as it laid the groundwork for subsequent reforms in the **Indian judicial system and police administration** during British rule.
